goal: Verify that a user can successfully create a new Site Host account and then navigate the calendar view to the following month.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field.
Click the blue 'Sign up' button to submit the registration.
Once the dashboard loads and displays the calendar for 'June 2026', click the right-pointing arrow button (Next month) located next to the month title.
success_criteria: The application navigates from the registration page to the main dashboard view without displaying error messages.
The calendar widget initially displays 'June 2026' upon successful login.
After clicking the navigation button, the calendar header updates to display 'July 2026'.
The calendar grid correctly reflects the dates for July 2026.
